# Broward Behavioral Health Coalition

> > Broward Behavioral Health Coalition (BBHC) is Florida's Managing Entity for behavioral health services in Broward County, coordinating mental health, substance abuse, and housing support for vulnerable populations.

BBHC manages the provider network, policies, and recovery-oriented systems of care for Broward County residents. The organization operates through advisory councils, quality improvement committees, and partnerships with local healthcare providers to deliver comprehensive behavioral health services.

## Key Topics

- Broward Behavioral Health Coalition (BBHC)
- Recovery Oriented System of Care (ROSC)
- Clinical Continuous Quality Improvement (CCQI)
- Provider Network Management
- Housing Initiative
- Incident Reporting and Analysis System (IRAS)
- Broward Homelessness Continuum of Care (FL-601)
- Intensive Case Management
- Substance Abuse Services
- Mental Health Services
- Provider Advisory Council
- Contract Management
- Compliance Guidelines
- Behavioral Health Coordination
- Broward County Services

## Core Services & Programs

- [Housing Initiative](https://bbhcflorida.org/housing-initiative): BBHC housing coordination for mental health and substance use populations
- [Intensive Case Management](https://bbhcflorida.org/services_provided/intensive-case-management): Intensive case management for homeless individuals in Broward County

## Provider Network

- [Broward Health](https://bbhcflorida.org/provider_network/broward-health): Broward Health provider offering psychiatric and substance abuse services
- [Covenant House Florida, Inc.](https://bbhcflorida.org/provider_network/covenant-house-florida-inc): Covenant House Florida homeless youth shelter and transitional housing

## Policies & Compliance

- [Policies and Procedures](https://bbhcflorida.org/policies-and-procedures): BBHC policies, procedures, IRAS reporting, and compliance guidelines

## Contact & Locations
